beekeeper.summary: A cheerful blonde beekeeper with a wide cream hat, a bee on the crown, a short net veil, a cream suit, yellow gloves, and a honey pot with a dipper. It is the same character as the mockup, but the hair, the veil, and the pot have clear differences.
strengths: The wide cream hat with the bee on the crown is the signature shape. It reads from every view and in every sprite direction.
The face reads well. The brown eyes, the blush, and the closed smile match the mockup expression.
The yellow gloves, the brown boots, and the cream suit match the mockup palette.
The translucent veil reads as a net material.
The model is clean. The hair stays under the brim and inside the veil, and the pot touches the glove.
issues: The hair is a short bob under the brim. The mockup has large, wavy blonde hair that extends out to the shoulders. Add volume and waves at the sides and the back.
The veil is a short band from the brim to eye level. In the mockup, the net lies on the brim and hangs to the shoulders. Make the veil longer and softer, and gather a part of it on the brim.
The pot is small and orange, with no clear neck or rim. The mockup pot is larger and brown, with a jar shape. Make the pot larger and browner, give it a neck and a rim, and make the dipper shorter.
The suit reads as a short smock above the boots. The mockup shows a full coverall with cuffs and legs that go into the boots. Show more of the suit legs above the boot tops.
The free arm hangs down at the side. In the mockup, the free arm points out from the body. Move the free arm out a little.
In the walk, the pot arm stays still (a known base limit) and the body has little bob. The walk is readable but stiff.
beekeeper.next: Give the hair the large, wavy volume of the mockup at the sides and the back below the brim, and widen the veil so that the hair stays inside it.
